description: Likely cause and fix of a three.js error or warning from the console, a build, a test run or a bug report: missing exports and wrong import paths (with the right path for the installed version), classes that no longer exist, two copies of three, objects used before a model loaded, 404 HTML instead of a model, Draco/KTX2 decoders, NaN geometry, lost contexts, shader compile errors, CORS, file://, WebGPU init. Paste the message as it was printed. Read-only.

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.
